name: git-tree
title: Git Tree
description: A repository's files at a commit on UI SDK's Tree: folders first with lucide icons, changed files marked added, modified, deleted or renamed in their tone, folders that hold a change marked too. Virtualized for 100,000 files; agents open and expand by path.
docs: `<GitTree aria-label files onOpenFile current />`. `files` are paths (strings, a trailing `/` for an empty folder) or `{ path, status, from }` with `status` one of `added`, `modified`, `deleted`, `renamed`; the tree is UI SDK's `treeFromPaths`, so folders sort first. A changed file shows a one-letter mark (`labels.mark`) and its icon in the status tone, and its name reads "proration.ts, Modified" ("pdf.ts, Renamed, from src/invoice/print.ts"); folders that hold a change carry a dot and "Has changes". Folders with changes start open; `expanded`/`defaultExpanded`/`onExpandedChange` control them. Arrows, Home/End, typeahead and Left/Right come from UI SDK's Tree; a press or Enter on a file calls `onOpenFile(path)`, and `current` marks the file shown elsewhere. Rows virtualize (only those in view render, every one stays reachable by keyboard and agents); give it a bounded height. `findable` lets find in page reach files and folders out of view, by name, through UI SDK's findable layers built once the page is idle; off by default, as it costs up to a frame on some held-arrow presses at 100,000 files (p95 about 16 ms against 10 ms), and it caps the scroller at `--git-tree-height` (40rem). Agents get `open(path)` (a file, opening its folders first, or a folder), `expand(path)` and `collapse(path)`. Built on UI SDK's Tree directly; once a styled `tree` item ships, its rows can reuse it.
